stocks.label: Ledger
stocks.subject: Ledger: select many lines and change them together, with their total. Hold a line, Select, then a tap picks or drops more lines of the same list (Home's Recent, the full ledger, or Upcoming) instead of opening them. A bar at the foot says how many and what they come to in baht, with Date (each keeps its own time), Account, Category and Delete for all of them; the picks stay after a change so date and bank can both be changed. Transfers are never picked. Money deletes keep Undo; deleting upcoming lines asks first. Proof: bulk.mocked 4/4; ledger-bulk-e2e passes twice on the demo at phone width with real presses (pick, total, date, account, category, transfer refused, drop, close, delete + Undo, then Upcoming: total, date, delete); 6 mutants red (time not kept, transfer guard gone, unchanged account rewritten, a tap opens the line, total unsigned, picks dropped after a change); money 12/12, upcomingedit 5/5. ledger-boss-e2e fails the same way on the code before this. Asked: "Allow me to bulk select here so I can bulk change date bank etc", "And see how much money total they are. Including in smth like upcoming too".

weight.label: Weight
weight.subject: Weight: a home-screen widget, design B with Home's whole chart. The last weigh-in big with Home's chip beside it (kg a day, or the change in N days), the kg to go top right, and under them the eight weeks as Home draws them: the kg over every point with room, the first day, the goal on its date with its kg and day, and today's pace carried to that date, blue on track and red not. Drawn natively to whatever size it is given, in Manrope and the person's own colour on AMOLED black; a tap opens Weight. The page hands over whoever Home shows (colour, weigh-ins, goals) and Java does Home's sums again at every draw (WidgetPlan), so it moves on by itself with the app closed and turns light blue when Home switches to Mummy. Home's chip words moved into plan.js (chipOf), used by both.

translate.label: Translate
translate.subject: Translate: English or Thai is found by itself. Whatever you type, the app reads which language it is from the letters: more Thai letters than English ones is Thai (the English comes out), else English (the Thai comes out), so one Thai word in an English line ("I want to eat ข้าว") no longer turns the whole line round; numbers alone, or as many of each, go the way the button is set. After each translation the ไทย / EN button, the box's words and the widget's bar follow what you typed, and the keyboard is asked for that language the next time the box opens (not mid-word, which would break the typing). javacheck 35/35 (2 new tests); 2 mutants red (any Thai letter = Thai, a tie ignoring the button). Asked: "Can translate auto detect if it's eng or Thai please".

reddit.label: Reddit Snoo
reddit.subject: Reddit: You is the third tab, not Search. The footer is Home / All / You, and swiping across the tabs follows the same order. Search opens from the magnifier at the top of Home, All and a community (with a back arrow, no footer). Your picture at the top of Home and All is gone now that You is a tab, and You has no back arrow: back from it goes Home. Proof: e2e 316/316 checks pass, with new checks that the footer reads Home, All, You, that no picture sits at the top, that You's tab is lit on You, and that a swipe left on All lands on You. Putting Search back in the footer turns them red. Asked: "Instead of a search, the third for the Reddit app snoo should be you."
